cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with
 new symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the initial spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

respins.how_it_works:
HOLD & SPIN
 Whenever 3x or more hit anywhere on the screen it triggers the HOLD & SPIN BONUS.
When the feature starts the initial COIN MONEY symbols remain in place and the symbols on the other reels fade away.
 The grid of symbols remains of the same size as the spin that triggered the feature.
 The value of all initial COIN MONEY SYMBOLS are added to the total win of the round.
 Start with 3 respins. All COIN MONEY SYMBOLS that hit after each respin reset the number of respins back to 3 and
 the value of each COIN MONEY SYMBOL on the screen is added to the total win of the round.

collectors.name: MONEY
collectors.behavior:
FISH MONEY SYMBOL
 This is the FISH MONEY symbol.
 At every spin the FISH MONEY symbol, takes a random money value from a pre-defined set
 from 2x to 5000x total bet which can be won during the FREE SPINS feature.
 Possible values are: 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x or 5000x total bet.
 In the base game, the FISH MONEY symbols explode and tumble normally. In the free spins,
 they do not explode and just fall to the bottom of the screen as tumbles happen.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS round can be instantly triggered from the base game by buying it for 100x current total bet.
 When buying the FREE SPINS round, on the triggering spin 3, 4, 5 or 6 SCATTERS can hit randomly.

 BUY HOLD & SPIN FEATURE
The HOLD & SPIN FEATURE can be instantly triggered from the base game by buying it for 120x current total bet.
 When buying the HOLD & SPIN feature, the triggering spin will have 3 to 6 COIN MONEY symbols with random
 values.
